experiment: P3e frozen parallel lazy scheduler benchmark
research_question: Can parallel conditional scheduling reduce the frozen P2c expert pipeline to at most 1.5 times main-backbone batch-64 latency without changing any expert output?
method_changes: none to models, checkpoints, thresholds, routes, losses, or predictions; scheduling only

data.source: fresh P3d development identities, all five regimes and 25/35/50 dB

stop_rule: If the 1.5x gate fails, do not claim deployable low-overhead routing; retain the measured cost as a limitation and investigate shared-front-end replacement on new identities.
